title: Fairhaven cold room alarm runbook
brief: I'm the operations manager at Fairhaven Foods and I need a runbook for when a cold room temperature alarm goes off, for warehouse shift leads who will read it on a handheld phone at the dock, wearing gloves, so short steps and big thresholds. Dated 2026-10-14. Under "When to use this": the alarm sounds when Cold Room 1 or Cold Room 2 reads above 5 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes. Under "Steps" in order, with who and by when counted from the alarm: 1, the shift lead checks the door is shut and the compressor light is on, within 5 minutes; 2, the shift lead calls the refrigeration engineer on duty, within 10 minutes; 3, if the room reads above 8 degrees, forklift driver Bogdan Kowal and a picker start moving chilled pallets to the other cold room, within 15 minutes, finishing within 45; 4, the quality officer Ines Carvalho writes the start time and the highest reading in the log, within 30 minutes; 5, the shift lead tells the duty manager Callum Fraser, within 30 minutes. Under "Thresholds" as a table: up to 5 degrees, normal; above 5 for 10 minutes, alarm and steps 1 and 2; above 8, move stock; above 8 for a total of 4 hours, discard all chilled stock in that room and do not ship it. Under "Contacts": refrigeration engineer 0800 555 0188, Ines ext 3302, Callum ext 3300. Highlight the 4 hour discard rule as a warning.

edit.request: The alarm should now sound at 4 degrees instead of 5, and the discard rule becomes 3 hours instead of 4.
